_about: Recorded (text, classifier_response) pairs for the SEMANTIC attorney-handoff layer. classifier_response is the RAW model JSON (the string content the LLM would return for `text`); the replay runner feeds it through the real handoff_semantic.semantic_handoff() parse/_coerce/decision path via an injected mock client, so the live behavior is proven with NO billable key and NO network. These are illustrative, hand-authored fixtures (NOT captured from a paid run): each classifier_response is the conservative verdict the documented system prompt is designed to produce for that input. They exist only to pin the DECISION LOGIC, never to assert a specific vendor's wording.
threshold_note: handoff.SEMANTIC_CONFIDENCE_THRESHOLD = 0.75; high-risk fixtures sit above it on purpose.
